faqs.question: Can you transport a concert grand piano into a mansion block in NW8?
faqs.answer: Yes. We measure service elevators and stairwells in advance, fitting protective elevator wall pads and using specialized piano skids for lateral moves.

faqs.question: Do you arrange Westminster parking suspensions outside mansion blocks?
faqs.answer: Yes. We handle all paperwork with Westminster City Council to reserve legal curbside parking outside residential forecourts.

faqs.question: How do you protect marble and polished parquetry floors in St John’s Wood?
faqs.answer: Our porters lay heavy neoprene floor mats across all transit routes to prevent wheel impressions or scuffs on delicate flooring.
